title: Sources: carmakers find a workaround for chip shortages amid Nexperia's internal battle, buying wafers from its Dutch arm and then shipping themselves to China (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: carmakers find a workaround for chip shortages amid Nexperia's internal battle, buying wafers from its Dutch arm and then shipping themselves to China — Several auto groups are buying wafers from chipmaker's Dutch arm, and shipping them to its Chinese unit to avoid output stoppages
